name: whisper-monorepo
description: Whisper — push-to-talk voice dictation. Self-hosted API + Electron desktop client.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @whisper/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @whisper/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @whisper/app
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @whisper/server && npm run build --workspace @whisper/app
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace @whisper/app
